title: spec(security): tenancy-posture.ts still says "open code does not mean free activation" and keeps the pre-ADR-0132 "not by giving the posture away" paragraph
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ② should-fixes 1 and 2 of the spec seat's post-merge contract review on PR #29239 (#28826), at its landing head `e6a8c4d7`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:spec`, prose only in `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` (the file has no `.describe()`, so nothing generated moves).

## What is left after PR #29239

- **"open code does not mean free activation"** is kept, in the file header and repeated unchanged in the `postureStampsOrganization` docblock. It now sits next to "That runtime is open code too". On an open install, activation is gate-free by construction: `organizations-plugin.ts` ≈L243 has no licence gate, ≈L236 entitles `supportedPostures: ['group','isolated']`, and ADR-0132 D4 says the same. ADR-0105 D12's amendment carries the qualifier this sentence lacks: "on the commercial side".
- **The Cloud ADR-0016 铁律 paragraph** (header ≈L35–38, "not by giving the posture away") predates ADR-0132 and now contradicts the paragraph PR #29239 rewrote above it. The PR recorded it as "noted, not filed".

## Done when

Both sentences say what is true on each side: free activation on an open install (ADR-0132 D4), the licence gate on a commercial host (D2, D3). Spec patch, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe: #28826 / PR #29239 (the "enterprise" wording, landed). **New.**
